$comment: Scout (Flow 0, Step 7) column-definition array for List B = 'Subscription Register'. One row per recurring newsletter/promo/FYI SENDER DOMAIN (not per email). WRITE PATH (decision #1, confirmed 2026-07-03): Sorter (Flow 1) upserts INLINE — when it classifies a message as PROMOTIONS/SUBSCRIPTIONS/MISC or an FYI-reference subtype, it upserts here keyed on Sender Domain (Title), incrementing Message Count and stamping Last Seen; no dedicated Flow 2. Never-Opened Flag (old col #9) DROPPED for pilot (decision #2). Field-creation mechanics identical to List A — see scout_listA_columns_README.md (CreateFieldAsXml, Options=12, create in array order, concurrency=1, XML-escape values). FieldTypeKind: Text=2, Note=3, DateTime=4, Choice=6, Boolean=8, Number=9.

titleRename.note: The built-in Title IS the upsert key (sender domain, e.g. mailchimp.com). PATCH/MERGE Title -> 'Sender Domain'; do not create a separate field. Sorter upserts by matching this.

columns.description: Friendly display name of the most recent sender from this domain.
Most recent full from-address (a domain can have several).
Set by Sorter at upsert from the message's classification.
Incremented on every upsert — the 'how noisy is this' signal; default view sorts on it desc.
Human-set. Internal name is 'SubStatus' to avoid colliding with any built-in; display shows 'Status'.
Same set as List A. Most Promo/FYI resolve to N/A; vendor marketing may map to P5.
Stamped when Status changes (List A convention).
